title: 3D Heart structure cards (Step 7, T7.0, frozen 14 Nov 2026)
description: One card per teachable structure. Written by Claude, reviewed by Punnatorn + cardiology staff. Codex renders it (T7.1) and never edits the text. Short names on the model stay in explore-data.js SHORT (one source); the card shows `name`.

ref.description: A place the structure is seen. `id` must exist in its namespace (echo: echo-sim/data/views.json ids; cut: explore.js CUTS ids / RELEVANT_LABELS keys). `text` says what to look for.

id.description: Stable card id. Never renamed once published.

category.description: Small caps line above the title, e.g. 'Chamber', 'Valve', 'Coronary artery', 'Conduction'.

labelIds.description: Every tap id that opens this card: phantom label ids, landmark ids, 'artery:<id>', 'vein:<id>', 'conduction:<tap id>'. Each tap id belongs to exactly one card (checked by the validator).

parts.description: Sub-parts named on tap (leaflets, cusps, scallops, segments). A tap on `labelId` opens the card scrolled to this part and the callout reads '<name> — <part name>'. Replaces explore-data.js LEAFLET.

core.description: One sentence: what it is and why it matters. Always visible, also on phones.

supply.description: Blood supply; drainage or innervation where it teaches something. For arteries: the territory it feeds.

relations.description: Neighbours that explain a complication or a procedure risk.

scenario.description: Existing pathology scenario id (CONTENT.SC, SIMC.EXTRA, SIMC.MIS keys) → 'Run in simulator'. 'planned:<id>' → greyed chip 'Coming with the Pathology simulator'. null → no chip.

pearls.description: Student and resident: 2–4 each (priority audience). Fellow: optional, 0–3; when empty the Fellow button is greyed with 'Fellow pearls coming later'.

sources.description: Tags only (guideline, textbook, review). No copied text.

verify.description: Claims for staff to check (numbers, contested anatomy). Shown on the review sheet, not on the public card.
